title: forMedia
tagline: AI broadcast monitoring with real-time transcription and media intelligence
scope: A production platform that monitors 50+ live TV channels for 80+ analysts. It combines live and archived video, bilingual transcription, and AI (LLM/OCR) extraction so analysts can find, clip, and share what aired.
role: Frontend lead: owned architecture, code reviews, and delivery, mentored junior developers, and designed Django REST Framework endpoints for internal tools.
achievements: Built the live TV module on HLS.js with custom controls, in-browser clipping with metadata tagging, and DVR-style playback across a 180-day archive.
Architected the real-time data layer with Zustand and TanStack Query to stream LLM outputs and transcription updates while keeping the UI responsive.
Developed a bilingual English/Urdu transcription interface with Nastaliq rendering, full-text search, and click-to-seek sync with the video timeline.
Built a Ticker and Flasher dashboard that turns AI-extracted on-air headlines into an analyst workflow for filtering, editing, categorizing, and collage generation.
Architected a collaborative workspace for sharing AI-generated video highlights across departments, from Figma to responsive, WCAG-compliant interfaces.
Designed Django REST Framework API endpoints for internal tools, streamlining frontend–backend integration.

title: BetaNexus
tagline: GovTech production monitoring with AI detections on live factory camera feeds
scope: An industrial production monitoring platform for the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR). It overlays AI detections on live camera feeds and gives auditors production analytics across 48+ factory sites, designed to scale to 400+.
role: Frontend lead from inception: architecture, data layer, and video overlay pipeline, plus contract-first API design for the Network Monitoring (NMS) module.
achievements: Built an in-browser MPEG-TS parser (PES reassembly, ID3/TXXX extraction) that reads AI detection metadata from live HLS streams and draws bounding boxes, unit counts, and timestamps on a playback-synced Canvas overlay.
Built ApexCharts dashboards (heatmaps, line/bar charts, zoom, log scale) for SKU, production, mill-wise output, and downtime analytics across 48+ factory sites.
Architected a type-safe data layer with TanStack Query (polling, infinite pagination, cache invalidation) and Zod response validation to catch API contract drift early.
Made URL search params the single source of truth for filters, so every view is shareable, bookmarkable, and refresh-safe.
Implemented 2FA OTP login, silent token refresh via Axios interceptors, admin user management, and React Leaflet maps for factory search and onboarding.
Optimized rendering with the React 19 Compiler, memoization, and route-level lazy loading, with strict ESLint (no `any`) and Vitest in GitHub Actions CI.
Led contract-first API design for the NMS module, defining schemas and TypeScript types before backend implementation.
